canonical.title: A weekend at Reale, Castel di Sangro

siblings.title: Day-trips and activities within 30 km of Reale
siblings.summary: PNALM hikes, Marsican-bear corridor, Pescocostanzo, San Vincenzo al Volturno, half- and full-day loops.

siblings.title: Walking-distance lodging at or near Reale
siblings.summary: Casadonna itself; Hotel Don Luis and Sport Village are the closest fall-backs.

siblings.title: Special-character lodging within taxi range of Reale
siblings.summary: Heritage and boutique stays within a short taxi — Casadonna monastery, Renaissance palazzo in Pescocostanzo.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events within 30 km of Reale
siblings.summary: Zero open IT conferences within 30 km in 2026; nearest is L'Aquila, ~110 km north.

sources.title: nikoromito.com — Casadonna
sources.claim: Casadonna address (Piana Santa Liberata), ~10 named rooms across Classic/Superior/Suite tiers; on-site Reale.

sources.title: nikoromito.com — News
sources.claim: Reale and Casadonna closed 16 Mar – 9 Jun 2026; reopen 10 Jun for dinner service.

sources.title: Tripadvisor — Casadonna Reale
sources.claim: Casadonna 4.6/5; Reale is on-site, 1-minute walk from rooms; package ~€1,300+/night.

sources.title: Tripadvisor — Hotel Don Luis
sources.claim: Hotel Don Luis 4.3/5 (495 reviews); Via Sangro 94, ~400 m from Casadonna.

sources.title: sportvillagehotel.it
sources.claim: Sport Village Hotel & Spa, 4-star, indoor pool, Fluèntia spa, four restaurants.

sources.title: Tripadvisor — Il Lavatoio Dimora Storica
sources.claim: Il Lavatoio Dimora Storica in restored 18th-c communal washhouse, in town.

sources.title: Tripadvisor — Hotel Il Tiglio
sources.claim: Hotel Il Tiglio, adults-only, rated 9.4 by guests.

sources.title: letorrihotel.it
sources.claim: Hotel Le Torri occupies the 16th-c Palazzo Grilli on Pescocostanzo's Renaissance piazza.
